nodes.description: Collection of animations including route transitions, hero sequences, floating navbar, WebGL aurora shader, text animations, sliders, marquees, and decorative effects.

nodes.label: Edge Functions
nodes.description: Supabase Edge Functions for server-side operations: openrouter-chat, admin-data, account-delete, contact-submit.
